_comment: Platform MCP set — Linear + GitHub + Slack baseline. FinOps reads spend from the router's cost_ledger directly (internal, not MCP). Release Manager uses GitHub MCP for releases. ADR work uses file Read/Edit tools (not MCP). Verify package names before Phase 1 deploy.

linear._comment: In-process Linear MCP (mcp__linear__list_teams / list_labels / search_issues / create_issue / create_comment / create_label). Router-hosted wrapper over Linear's GraphQL API, authed with the session's ${LINEAR_TOKEN} (from Infisical LINEAR_TOKEN_platform). Only the always-allowed tier is exposed — status change / reassign / close / archive / delete are intentionally not tools (AGENTS.md tiered Linear scope). Replaces the deprecated @modelcontextprotocol/server-linear stdio package. See router/src/linear/linearMcp.ts. Platform files architectural-review tickets, incident-response tickets, finops cost-related tickets.

github._comment: GitHub MCP — release-manager creates release drafts; architect opens ADR PRs to docs/adrs/; incident-response posts to incident issues. Platform DOES write to GitHub but only to docs paths + the .github/ workflows it owns.

slack._comment: Slack MCP — FinOps posts to #agents-alerts; release-manager posts to #engineering; incident-response posts to #incidents.

_future_mcp_candidates._comment: Possible additions during Phase 3+ once toolbelt decisions land. NOT enabled at v1 — each requires verification + the right credentials in Infisical.
_future_mcp_candidates.stripe: If billing infrastructure uses Stripe, FinOps could pull subscription cost data via @modelcontextprotocol/server-stripe.
_future_mcp_candidates.anthropic-admin: If Anthropic ships an admin/billing MCP, FinOps could pull spend data directly (currently router pulls from cost_ledger SQLite).
_future_mcp_candidates.cloud-provider: If the project uses AWS/GCP/Hetzner heavily, a cloud-billing MCP can feed cloud-cost data into FinOps reports. Per-project decision.
